about: Ownership fixtures, run by tools/ci/test-hygiene.ps1. 'map' is the checked-out map (coverage; default docs/ownership.json); 'policyMap' is the merge base's map that judges the branch ('repo' for docs/ownership.json, 'none' for a merge base without one, else a fixture file; default: the same as 'map'). A 'fail' case must produce errors, and every 'match' regex must match one of them ('errors' pins their number); a 'pass' case must produce none, and every 'warn' regex must match a warning. 'labels' absent means the labels are unknown. 'verify' runs as CI does on a pull request, with the PR 'author' and the 'exceptionActor' who last applied the exception label. A shared-path change may carry its -U0 'hunks' and the file's 'baseLines' at the merge base.

cases.name: own-path-edit
cases.why: positive control: S1 edits its own Lrm.Core

cases.name: out-of-path-edit
cases.why: O1 edits a Lrm.Core file, which S1 owns
match: ^src/Lrm\.Core/Hash\.fs is owned by family S1, not by family O1

cases.name: slice-shares-family-paths
cases.why: positive control: R4b may edit R4a's files, since slices share the family's paths

cases.name: excluded-subtree
cases.why: R4 owns src/Lrm.Shaders/** except the kernel folders, which K1 to K3 own
match: ^src/Lrm\.Shaders/hlsl/kernels/basic/add\.hlsl is owned by family K1, not by family R4

cases.name: fix-branch
cases.why: positive control: ws/<id>-fix-<slug> maps to the same family

cases.name: deletion-outside-family
cases.why: deleting another family's file is an out-of-path edit too
match: ^src/Lrm\.Core/Telemetry\.fs is owned by family S1, not by family T1 \(branch ws/T1-telemetry-reports, status D\)

cases.name: new-unowned-file
cases.why: a new file that no family owns fails both coverage and the branch check
match: ^misc/notes\.txt is owned by no family in docs/ownership\.json$
^misc/notes\.txt is owned by no family, not by family S1

cases.name: unknown-workstream
cases.why: the id must be a slice in docs/ownership.json
match: ^branch 'ws/Z9-something' names workstream 'Z9', which is no slice

cases.name: id-is-case-sensitive
cases.why: slice ids match case-sensitively, so ws/s1-core is not S1
match: names workstream 's1', which is no slice

cases.name: branch-shape
cases.why: only ws/<id>-<slug>, ws/<id>-fix-<slug> and int/<slug> are allowed
match: ^branch 'feature/new-kernel' does not follow ws/<id>-<slug>, ws/<id>-fix-<slug> or int/<slug>$

cases.name: slug-is-lowercase
cases.why: slugs are lowercase letters and digits joined by hyphens
match: does not follow ws/<id>-<slug>

cases.name: integrator-any-path
cases.why: positive control: int/ branches may touch any path

cases.name: main-coverage-only
cases.why: positive control: on main only coverage is checked

cases.name: shared-append
cases.why: positive control: any family may append to docs/contracts/CHANGELOG.md

cases.name: shared-rewrite
cases.why: a family other than S0 may only add lines to the CHANGELOG
match: ^docs/contracts/CHANGELOG\.md is shared append-only .*deletes or rewrites 2 line\(s\)$

cases.name: shared-delete
cases.why: deleting the shared CHANGELOG is never an append
match: ^docs/contracts/CHANGELOG\.md is shared append-only .*this change deletes the file$

cases.name: exception-label
cases.why: the integrator's exception label turns a reviewed out-of-path edit into a warning
warn: ^docs/project-graph\.json is owned by family S0, not T1; accepted by the 'ownership-exception' label$

cases.name: exception-needs-known-labels
cases.why: without PR labels the exception cannot apply
match: ^docs/project-graph\.json is owned by family S0, not by family T1

cases.name: overlapping-map
cases.why: a map whose globs overlap, or that leaves a file unowned, fails coverage
match: ^src/A/shared\.fs is owned by several families \(A, B\)
^docs/orphan\.md is owned by no family

cases.name: self-granted-map
cases.why: a branch's own map cannot hand it paths: the merge base's map judges the diff, and the map itself is a governance path
match: ^docs/ownership\.json is a governance path
^src/Lrm\.Core/Rng\.fs is owned by family S1, not by family O1

cases.name: no-trusted-map
cases.why: a merge base without docs/ownership.json gives no map the branch did not write, so a ws/ branch fails closed
match: has no docs/ownership\.json, so the branch's changes cannot be judged by a map the branch did not write; rebase onto origin/main$

cases.name: partial-policy-map
cases.why: positive control: S0a's first map (families only, no contract section) still judges a branch whose merge base holds it

cases.name: governance-checker-edit
cases.why: outside S0, tools/ci/** never changes, so a branch cannot switch the checks off
match: ^tools/ci/Hygiene\.psm1 is a governance path \(the ownership map, the hygiene checks or CI\): only family S0 and int/ branches change it

cases.name: governance-beats-exception
cases.why: the exception label never covers a governance path, even when an integrator set it
match: ^\.github/workflows/ci\.yml is a governance path
^tools/ci/hygiene\.json is a governance path

cases.name: governance-own-family
cases.why: positive control: S0 changes its own checks and CI

cases.name: shared-append-at-end
cases.why: positive control: lines added after the last line of the merge base's CHANGELOG are an append

cases.name: shared-insert-inside
cases.why: a back-dated entry inserted into an older section is not an append
match: ^docs/contracts/CHANGELOG\.md is shared append-only .*this change inserts lines after line 12 of 40; entries are appended at the end of the file$

cases.name: int-author-verified
cases.why: positive control: in CI an int/ PR by an integrator passes, and the summary lists it
cases.author: enderPeer
warn: ^int/ branch: integrator rights used by enderPeer \(an integrator\), so its 1 changed path\(s\) are not checked against the map$

cases.name: int-author-not-integrator
cases.why: in CI an int/ branch is not a way around the diff check for anyone but the integrator
cases.author: some-agent
match: ^int/ branches belong to the integrator \(enderPeer, rosylina2\), but the PR author is some-agent; use ws/<id>-<slug>$

cases.name: int-unverified-local
cases.why: positive control: outside CI an int/ branch passes, with a warning that the author is verified in CI only
warn: ^int/ branch: integrator rights claimed, so its 1 changed path\(s\) are not checked against the map; CI verifies that the PR author is an integrator$

cases.name: exception-set-by-integrator
cases.why: positive control: in CI the exception counts when an integrator applied the label
warn: ^docs/project-graph\.json is owned by family S0, not T1; accepted by the 'ownership-exception' label$

cases.name: exception-set-by-agent
cases.why: in CI the exception does not count when someone other than an integrator applied the label
match: ^the 'ownership-exception' label was set by some-agent, who is not an integrator \(enderPeer, rosylina2\), so it does not apply
^docs/project-graph\.json is owned by family S0, not by family T1

cases.name: exception-actor-unknown
cases.why: in CI an exception whose author cannot be read does not count (fail closed)
match: ^the 'ownership-exception' label was set by someone CI could not determine, so it does not apply
